title: Name the before-minus-after difference
spoken: Delta K is defined as K before minus K after.
explanation: Delta K is shorthand for a difference, not an additional energy law. Its before-minus-after sign is the reverse of a signed after-minus-before change.
assumptions: Delta K is defined here as kinetic energy before minus after. The definition alone supplies no physical value.
This is modern explanatory notation, not a printed source transcription.

notes.title: Positive kinetic-energy drop
notes.explanation: ΔK means K₀ − K₁ in this card: before minus after. It is identified from the ledger subtraction only under the unchanged-offset premise.

notes.title: Energy of motion before
notes.explanation: K₀ is energy of motion before emission, relative to the moving observer. The subtraction does not determine its absolute value.

notes.title: Energy of motion after
notes.explanation: K₁ is energy of motion after emission at the same speed. Comparing the two kinetic energies identifies a drop without inventing their absolute values.

notes.title: Subtract the whole expression
notes.explanation: The negative sign applies to every term in the second expression. Both accounts use the same body boundary.
